description: Defines the class NestedIntSymNodeImpl, which models nested integer symbolic nodes used for representing ragged tensor sizes and their inequalities, including methods for comparison and string representation.

classes.name: NestedIntSymNodeImpl
classes.description: A class representing nested integer symbolic nodes for ragged tensor size structures, supporting inequality comparisons and string conversion.

methods.name: NestedIntSymNodeImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the nested int symbolic node with a value and coefficient.

methods.name: bool_
methods.description: Returns false, indicating this node is not a boolean.

methods.name: is_int
methods.description: Returns true, indicating this node represents an integer.

methods.name: is_float
methods.description: Returns false, indicating this node is not a float.

methods.name: is_bool
methods.description: Returns false, indicating this node is not a boolean.

methods.name: is_nested_int
methods.description: Returns true, indicating this node is a nested integer.

methods.name: has_hint
methods.description: Returns true, indicating the node has a hint.

methods.name: wrap_int
methods.description: Wraps an integer into a SymNode.

methods.name: guard_int
methods.description: Throws an error; not applicable for this node.

methods.name: guard_float
methods.description: Throws an error; not applicable for this node.

methods.name: guard_bool
methods.description: Throws an error; not applicable for this node.

methods.name: int_
methods.description: Throws an error; not applicable for this node.

methods.name: str
methods.description: Returns string representation of the node, e.g., 'j0' or 'coeff*j0'.

methods.name: eq
methods.description: Returns a symbolic node representing equality comparison.

methods.name: ne
methods.description: Returns a symbolic node representing inequality comparison.

methods.name: ge
methods.description: Returns a symbolic node representing 'greater than or equal' comparison.

methods.name: gt
methods.description: Returns a symbolic node representing 'greater than' comparison.

methods.name: lt
methods.description: Returns a symbolic node representing 'less than' comparison.

methods.name: le
methods.description: Returns a symbolic node representing 'less than or equal' comparison.

methods.name: mul
methods.description: Returns a symbolic node representing multiplication.

methods.name: nested_int
methods.description: Returns the nested integer value if available.

methods.name: nested_int_coeff
methods.description: Returns the coefficient associated with the nested integer.

methods.name: is_symbolic
methods.description: Returns false, indicating this node is not symbolic.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the node.
